definitions.gloss: to supervise; to oversee; to manage
definitions.explanation: To watch over and manage people or work to ensure things are done properly. Used in workplaces, organizations, and institutional contexts.

definitions.gloss: to direct (a film, play, or sports team)
definitions.explanation: To serve as the director of a movie, theatrical production, or as the manager/coach of a sports team.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}を{監督|かんとく}する。
{部下|ぶか}の{仕事|しごと}を{監督|かんとく}する{立場|たちば}にある。
examples.english: I am in a position to supervise my subordinates' work.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}が{金融機関|きんゆうきかん}を{監督|かんとく}する{仕組|しく}みが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A system for the government to supervise financial institutions is necessary.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}を{監督|かんとく}したのは{誰|だれ}ですか。
{彼|かれ}は{高校|こうこう}の{野球|やきゅう}チームを{監督|かんとく}している。
examples.english: He manages a high school baseball team.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{監督|かんとく}が{新作|しんさく}の{映画|えいが}を{監督|かんとく}することが{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: It was announced that a famous director will direct a new film.

notes:
Both the noun {監督|かんとく} (director, supervisor, manager) and the verb {監督|かんとく}する are extremely common. The noun form is used as a title in both film and sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工事|こうじ}を{監督|かんとく}する: to supervise construction
- {映画|えいが}を{監督|かんとく}する: to direct a film
- チームを{監督|かんとく}する: to manage a team
- {監督|かんとく}{責任|せきにん}: supervisory responsibility
- {監督|かんとく}{不行届|ふゆきとどき}: inadequate supervision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {管理|かんり}する: to manage, administer — focuses on systems and processes
- {指導|しどう}する: to instruct, guide — emphasizes teaching
- {統率|とうそつ}する: to lead, command — emphasizes leadership over a group

USAGE:
As a noun, {監督|かんとく} is used as a title: {映画監督|えいがかんとく} (film director), {野球|やきゅう}の{監督|かんとく} (baseball manager).
